扩散模型中流动蒸馏的定量近似框架A Quantitative Approximation Framework for Flow Distillation in Diffusion Models†00脚注文本：footnotetext:† 所有作者对这项工作的贡献均等，并按字母顺序列出。通讯作者为周韩飞。高卫国的工作得到了国家重点研发计划（批准号：2021YFA1003305）的部分支持。石雷的工作得到了国家自然科学基金（批准号：12571099）的部分支持。† All authors contributed equally to this work and are listed alphabetically. Weiguo Gao School of Mathematical Sciences, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China Shanghai Key Laboratory of Contemporary Applied Mathematics, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China Email: wggao@fudan.edu.cn, mingli23@m.fudan.edu.cn, leishi@fudan.edu.cn, zhouhf23@m.fudan.edu.cn Ming Li School of Mathematical Sciences, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China Shanghai Key Laboratory of Contemporary Applied Mathematics, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China Email: wggao@fudan.edu.cn, mingli23@m.fudan.edu.cn, leishi@fudan.edu.cn, zhouhf23@m.fudan.edu.cn Lei Shi School of Mathematical Sciences, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China Shanghai Key Laboratory of Contemporary Applied Mathematics, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China Email: wggao@fudan.edu.cn, mingli23@m.fudan.edu.cn, leishi@fudan.edu.cn, zhouhf23@m.fudan.edu.cn Hanfei Zhou School of Mathematical Sciences, Fudan University, Shanghai, 200433, China
摘要Abstract

我们开发了一个用于扩散蒸馏的定量近似框架，将几步采样视为学习流图组合下的误差传播。重点关注概率流常微分方程的轨迹蒸馏，我们发现局部逼近误差在低噪声多模态中会被强烈放大，其中基础动力学变得僵硬。在分析上易于处理的高斯混合 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 设置中，我们分离了两个核心困难：近似与时间相关的得分场和控制由概率流 ODE 的时间积分雅克比边界控制的动态放大。在近似方面，我们证明了建设性的We develop a quantitative approximation framework for diffusion distillation, viewing few-step sampling as error propagation under compositions of learned flow maps. Focusing on trajectory distillation for the probability-flow ODE, we show that local approximation errors can be strongly amplified in low-noise multimodal regimes, where the underlying dynamics become stiff. In an analytically tractable Gaussian-mixture Ornstein–Uhlenbeck setting, we separate two core difficulties: approximating the time-dependent score field and controlling the dynamical amplification governed by the time-integrated Jacobian bound of the probability-flow ODE. On the approximation side, we prove constructiveLp​(pt)L^{p}(p_{t})保证表明 ReLU-ReQU 网络随着时间的推移均匀地近似高斯混合分数，深度和宽度在目标精度上以多对数缩放，并明确地使用混合几何。在稳定性方面，我们得出一个明确的界限guarantees showing that ReLU–ReQU networks approximate the Gaussian-mixture score uniformly over time, with depth and width scaling polylogarithmically in the target accuracy and explicitly with the mixture geometry. On the stability side, we derive an explicit boundL​(t)L(t)计算概率流速的空间 Lipschitz 常数，并将其转换为由下式控制的流量图稳定性估计：for the spatial Lipschitz constant of the probability-flow velocity and convert it into a flow map stability estimate governed by∫stL​(u)​𝑑u\int_{s}^{t}L(u)\,du，使得刚性状态下的后期放大变得可计算。基于这些估计，我们证明深层残余成分有效地近似长视界传输，全局误差由稳定性放大因子控制，并确定了一种利普希茨失配机制，其中一步蒸馏在结构上是不利的。由此产生的理论产生了通过累积稳定性坐标中的均匀划分获得的稳定性平衡的非均匀时间网格。实验支持预测并将端到端相对 MSE 降低多达, making late-time amplification in stiff regimes computable. Building on these estimates, we prove that deep residual compositions efficiently approximate the long-horizon transport, with global error controlled by the stability amplification factor, and identify a Lipschitz-mismatch regime in which one-step distillation is structurally unfavorable. The resulting theory yields a stability-balanced non-uniform time grid obtained by uniform partitioning in the cumulative stability coordinate. Experiments support the prediction and reduce end-to-end relative MSE by up to51.9%51.9\%与with88分段与均匀网格相比。segments compared with uniform grids.

1 简介Introduction

本文从近似论的角度研究深度神经网络的扩散蒸馏。目标是将长视野生成传输压缩为少量学习映射，同时保持样本质量。扩散模型已成为生成建模的领先范例，可实现跨模态的高保真合成，并在科学和工程应用中得到越来越多的使用This paper studies diffusion distillation with deep neural networks from the perspective of approximation theory. The goal is to compress a long-horizon generative transport into a small number of learned maps while preserving sample quality. Diffusion models have become a leading paradigm for generative modeling, enabling high-fidelity synthesis across modalities and finding increasing use in scientific and engineering applications[14, 23, 42]。在他们的连续时间公式中. In their continuous-time formulation[42]，前向随机过程将复杂的数据分布传输到简单的高斯先验，并引入一系列边际, a forward stochastic process transports a complex data distribution to a simple Gaussian prior and induces a family of marginals{pt}t∈[0,T]\{p_{t}\}_{t\in[0,T]}。然后，生成相当于通过反时随机微分方程 (SDE) 或确定性概率流常微分方程 (ODE) 来反转这种传输，它们具有相同的边际定律。这个公式减少了学习估计分数的过程. Generation then amounts to reversing this transport through either the reverse-time stochastic differential equation (SDE) or the deterministic probability flow ordinary differential equation (ODE), which share the same marginal laws. This formulation reduces learning to estimating the score∇𝒙log⁡pt​(𝒙)\nabla_{\bm{x}}\log p_{t}(\bm{x})，或等效的速度场，并将采样减少为所得动力学的数值积分。因此，生成质量既取决于学习矢量场的准确性，也取决于近似误差沿长视界流传播的方式。, or equivalently a velocity field, and reduces sampling to numerical integration of the resulting dynamics. Thus, generation quality depends both on the accuracy of the learned vector field and on the way approximation errors propagate along the long-horizon flow.

对长时域数值积分的需求使得扩散模型的推理成本高昂，并激发了加速采样的大量工作。早期的方法主要集中于快速求解器，这些求解器重用预训练模型并通过改进的离散化或高阶 ODE 方案（包括 DDIM）减少函数评估的数量The need for long-horizon numerical integration makes inference with diffusion models expensive, and has motivated substantial work on accelerating sampling. Early approaches mainly focused on fast solvers that reuse a pretrained model and reduce the number of function evaluations through improved discretizations or higher-order ODE schemes, including DDIM[40], DPM 求解器, DPM-Solver[31], 联合电脑, UniPC[55]和 EDM 式采样设计, and EDM-style sampling designs[25]。这些方法可以大大减少计算量，但它们仍然需要多个模型评估，并且当步骤预算变得非常小时，它们的样本质量可能会下降。最近，蒸馏已成为加速扩散采样的广泛使用的替代方案。特别是，. These methods can substantially reduce computation, but they still require multiple model evaluations and their sample quality may degrade when the step budget becomes very small. More recently, distillation has become a widely used alternative for accelerating diffusion sampling. In particular,轨迹蒸馏trajectory distillation通过学习少量学生更新来压缩预训练采样器，这些更新模仿教师的多步逆时去噪轨迹，如渐进蒸馏中那样compresses a pretrained sampler by learning a small number of student updates that imitate the teacher’s multistep reverse-time denoising trajectory, as in progressive distillation[36]、一致性模型, consistency models[41]，以及无数据变体，例如 BOOT, and data-free variants such as BOOT[19]。其他蒸馏策略，包括分布匹配. Other distillation strategies, including distribution matching[58, 52, 51]和对抗性蒸馏and adversarial distillation[37]，而是强调全球分布调整或感知目标，并且不需要再现教师动态。与此同时，另一项工作从头开始训练通用的单步或少步生成器，例如平均流模型, instead emphasize global distributional alignment or perceptual objectives and need not reproduce the teacher dynamics. In parallel, another line of work trains generic one-step or few-step generators from scratch, such as mean-flow models[18]和捷径扩散模型and shortcut diffusion models[13]。我们专注于轨迹蒸馏，因为它保留了教师作为参考传输，并将几步采样转变为误差传播问题：局部差异可以通过与参考流的雅可比行列式相关的 Grönwall 因子放大，特别是在动态变得僵硬的低噪声、多模态情况下。. We focus on trajectory distillation because it retains the teacher as a reference transport and turns few-step sampling into an error-propagation problem: local discrepancies can be amplified by the Grönwall factor associated with the Jacobian of the reference flow, especially in low-noise, multimodal regimes where the dynamics become stiff.

尽管实证进展迅速，但对扩散蒸馏的理论理解仍然有限。特别是，目前尚不清楚如何量化当教师的长视野传输被少量学习的地图取代时所产生的误差，以及这些误差如何在构图下累积。因此，理论观点对于澄清少步学生的局限性以及指导原理算法和时间网格设计很有用。我们现在用概率流图形式化这个观点。Despite rapid empirical progress, the theoretical understanding of diffusion distillation remains limited. In particular, it is still unclear how to quantify the error incurred when a teacher’s long-horizon transport is replaced by only a small number of learned maps, and how these errors accumulate under composition. A theoretical viewpoint is therefore useful for clarifying the limitations of few-step students and for guiding principled algorithm and time-grid design. We now formalize this perspective in terms of probability-flow maps.

这种分解导致了以下分析策略。我们首先量化近似与边缘相关的时间相关分数或等效的概率流速度所需的网络复杂性This decomposition leads to the following analysis strategy. We first quantify the network complexity required to approximate the time-dependent score, or equivalently the probability-flow velocity, associated with the marginals{pt}t∈[0,T]\{p_{t}\}_{t\in[0,T]}，并跟踪这种复杂性如何取决于混合物分布的几何形状。然后，我们将这些近似估计与诱导流的稳定性界限相结合，以获得有限时间流图的有效神经网络近似, and track how this complexity depends on the geometry of the mixture distribution. We then combine these approximation estimates with stability bounds for the induced flow to obtain efficient neural-network approximations of finite-time flow mapsΦs←t\Phi_{s\leftarrow t}，包括目标精度方面的明确深度和宽度缩放以及控制误差放大的稳定性量。这种观点产生了蒸馏难度的分段测量，并导致非均匀时间离散化，在整个范围内平衡了这种难度。, including explicit depth and width scalings in terms of the target accuracy and the stability quantities controlling error amplification. This viewpoint yields a segment-wise measure of distillation difficulty and leads to a non-uniform time discretization that balances this difficulty over the full horizon.

为了保持分析的易处理性，同时又不消除导致多模态刚度的机制，我们专门研究由 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) 前向过程演化而来的各向同性高斯混合模型 (GMM) 初始化。这种专门化并没有淡化蒸馏问题。相反，它提供了一个封闭形式的环境，其中两个相关的困难来源可以被隔离。在这个 GMM-OU 设置中，每个边际To keep the analysis tractable without removing the mechanism responsible for multimodal stiffness, we specialize to an isotropic Gaussian mixture model (GMM) initialization evolved by an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck (OU) forward process. This specialization does not trivialize the distillation problem; rather, it gives a closed-form setting in which the two relevant sources of difficulty can be isolated. In this GMM–OU setting, each marginalptp_{t}仍然是高斯混合，因此分数remains a Gaussian mixture, and hence both the score∇𝒙log⁡pt​(𝒙)\nabla_{\bm{x}}\log p_{t}(\bm{x})和黑森州and the Hessian∇𝒙2log⁡pt​(𝒙)\nabla_{\bm{x}}^{2}\log p_{t}(\bm{x})有明确的公式。这些公式产生概率流速度场雅可比行列式的可计算界限，进而通过 Grönwall 参数给出流图稳定性估计，并量化扰动随时间的放大。相同的封闭式结构将两种效果分开。在每个固定时间，分数近似仍然是一个重要的神经近似问题，其复杂性取决于混合几何形状。随着时间的推移，局部逼近误差通过流动传播，并且当积分稳定性界限很大时可能累积成大的轨迹误差。这种分离是后续理论的基础，并激发了多级蒸馏中使用的稳定性平衡离散化策略。have explicit formulas. These formulas yield computable bounds on the Jacobian of the probability-flow velocity field, which in turn give flow map stability estimates through Grönwall arguments and quantify the amplification of perturbations over time. The same closed-form structure separates two effects. At each fixed time, score approximation remains a nontrivial neural approximation problem whose complexity depends on the mixture geometry. Across time, local approximation errors are propagated by the flow and may accumulate into large trajectory errors when the integrated stability bound is large. This separation underlies the subsequent theory and motivates the stability-balanced discretization strategy used in multistage distillation.

The resulting stability-balanced grid refines the time discretization where the amplification is largest and provides an explicit, model-driven strategy for multistage distillation.

组织。Organization.

本文的其余部分组织如下。The remainder of the paper is organized as follows.Section 3引入 GMM-OU 设置并导出分数、Hessian 矩阵和概率流 ODE 的稳定性界限的封闭式公式。introduces the GMM–OU setting and derives closed-form formulas for the score, the Hessian, and the stability bound of the probability-flow ODE.Section 4研究 ReLU-ReQU 网络的分数近似，并量化所需的网络复杂性如何取决于混合参数和目标精度。studies score approximation by ReLU–ReQU networks and quantifies how the required network complexity depends on the mixture parameters and the target accuracy.Section 5使用基于雅可比的稳定性界来识别一步蒸馏的 Lipschitz 失配障碍，证明了深度残差组合对有限时间流图的有效近似结果，并开发了一种稳定性平衡的时间离散化规则。uses the Jacobian-based stability bound to identify a Lipschitz-mismatch obstruction for one-step distillation, proves an efficient approximation result for finite-time flow maps by deep residual compositions, and develops a stability-balanced time discretization rule.Section 6提供经验验证，附录包含证明和支持技术结果。provides empirical validation, and the appendices contain proofs and supporting technical results.

2 相关工作Related Work

扩散模型的理论研究。Theoretical studies of diffusion models.

一种理论研究一般分布假设下的扩散模型，并建立近似、统计和计算保证。逼近结果表明，在合适的结构假设下，深度网络可以逼近得分函数，同时避免维数灾难One line of theory studies diffusion models under general distributional assumptions and establishes approximation, statistical, and computational guarantees. Approximation results show that deep networks can approximate score functions while avoiding the curse of dimensionality under suitable structural assumptions[9, 35, 43, 48]。统计分析进一步表明，样本复杂性可能取决于数据分布的内在维度，而不是环境维度. Statistical analyses further show that the sample complexity can depend on the intrinsic dimension of the data distribution rather than the ambient dimension[4, 5, 26]。其他作品将分数匹配与神经切线核连接起来以获得泛化界限. Other works connect score matching with neural tangent kernels to obtain generalization bounds[21]，或为高阶免训练采样方案提供评估复杂度保证, or provide evaluation-complexity guarantees for higher-order training-free sampling schemes[28].

第二行工作研究可分析处理的扩散模型，其中高斯混合作为规范模型类，用于导出更清晰的保证。在这种情况下，先前的工作研究了参数可识别性和恢复A second line of work studies diffusion models in analytically tractable regimes, with Gaussian mixtures serving as a canonical model class for deriving sharper guarantees. In this setting, prior work has studied parameter identifiability and recovery[17, 38], 求解器鲁棒性, solver robustness[24, 30, 20]，以及精确反演或多项式近似的机制, and mechanisms for exact inversion or polynomial approximation[53, 47]。相同的混合框架也被用于表征分布动态和采样限制，包括特征出现的关键窗口. The same mixture framework has also been used to characterize distributional dynamics and sampling limits, including critical windows for feature emergence[29]，样本复杂度估计, sample-complexity estimates[8]和离散化界限, and discretization bounds[46]。它进一步实现了对培训目标的分析，包括指导的局限性. It has further enabled analyses of training objectives, including limitations of guidance[7]，记忆权衡, memorization trade-offs[3, 15, 57]，和速度场匹配, and velocity field matching[45]。这些工作提供了对扩散动力学的重要见解，但它们没有量化当连续时间流被短序列的学习图取代时出现的组合误差，这是轨迹蒸馏的核心操作。. These works provide important insights into diffusion dynamics, but they do not quantify the composition error that arises when a continuous-time flow is replaced by a short sequence of learned maps, which is the central operation in trajectory distillation.

我们的工作属于这条分析路线，但重点关注缺失的组成机制。我们将蒸馏公式化为组合下的流图近似，并导出将段级近似误差与动态放大分开的界限。为了量化这种放大，我们专门研究从高斯混合初始化的奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程。这种设置仍然很重要：尽管前向动力学是线性的，但多模态初始化会产生非线性得分场，其中后验混合权重可以快速变化，从而捕获低噪声状态下概率流的刚度和扰动敏感性。通过导出分数及其雅可比行列式的封闭式表达式，我们获得了概率流 ODE 的时间相关雅可比行列式的可计算界限。该分析解释了为什么即使分数在固定时间精确近似，少步学生也可能在僵化的多模态体系中失败，并且它激发了稳定性平衡离散化规则，这些规则细化了误差放大最强的时间网格。Our work belongs to this analytic line, but focuses on the missing composition mechanism. We formulate distillation as flow map approximation under composition and derive bounds that separate segment-level approximation error from dynamical amplification. To quantify this amplification, we specialize to an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process initialized from a Gaussian mixture. This setting remains nontrivial: although the forward dynamics are linear, the multimodal initialization induces a nonlinear score field in which posterior mixture weights can change rapidly, capturing the stiffness and perturbation sensitivity of the probability flow in low-noise regimes. By deriving closed-form expressions for the score and its Jacobian, we obtain computable bounds on the time-dependent Jacobian of the probability-flow ODE. This analysis explains why few-step students may fail in stiff multimodal regimes even when the score is accurately approximated at fixed times, and it motivates stability-balanced discretization rules that refine the time grid where error amplification is strongest.

稳定性、刚度和 Lipschitz 约束。Stability, stiffness, and Lipschitz constraints.

相关的工作研究扩散动力学的稳定性和平滑特性，因为僵硬的矢量场和大的 Lipschitz 常数会阻碍训练和采样A related line of work studies stability and smoothness properties of diffusion dynamics, since stiff vector fields and large Lipschitz constants can hinder both training and sampling[54, 50]。这种规律性观点导致了末期缩放和利普希茨指导的时间表设计，以减轻原点附近的奇异行为和模式崩溃. This regularity viewpoint has led to end-time scaling and Lipschitz-guided schedule design for mitigating singular behavior and mode collapse near the origin[50, 6]。在高斯混合设置中，研究人员还导出了与组件无关的 Lipschitz 边界，并设计了具有严格采样稳定性保证的矩匹配求解器. Within Gaussian mixture settings, researchers have also derived component-independent Lipschitz bounds and designed moment-matching solvers with rigorous sampling stability guarantees[30, 20].

我们的理论将这种稳定性观点直接与多级蒸馏联系起来。我们表明，流段的难度不仅取决于固定时间分数近似，还取决于诱导流的刚度及其对扰动的敏感性。这揭示了分数场相对容易近似而组合传输仍然高度不稳定的情况。基于所得的时间相关雅可比界，我们推导了稳定性平衡的离散化规则，该规则细化了放大率较大的时间网格，从而减少了刚性状态下的误差累积。Our theory connects this stability viewpoint directly to multistage distillation. We show that the difficulty of a flow segment is determined not only by fixed-time score approximation, but also by the stiffness of the induced flow and its sensitivity to perturbations. This reveals regimes in which the score field is comparatively easy to approximate while the composed transport remains highly unstable. Based on the resulting time-dependent Jacobian bound, we derive a stability-balanced discretization rule that refines the time grid where amplification is large, thereby reducing error accumulation in stiff regimes.

This motivates using a time grid to partition the generation process and approximating the flow map on each subinterval separately, as in piecewise distillation methods. Such a strategy helps control error propagation across the composed transport.

4.1 假设类Hypothesis class

我们首先定义用于分数近似的网络架构。我们使用混合 ReLU 和 ReQU 激活的前馈网络。这种架构的近似特性已被广泛研究We first define the network architecture used for score approximation. We use feedforward networks with mixed ReLU and ReQU activations. Approximation properties of such architectures have been studied extensively[2, 27, 49, 56]。 ReLU 单元允许精确实现截断和最大类型运算，而 ReQU 单元提供基本多项式运算（例如平方和乘积）的精确构造。因此，这种混合架构非常适合 GMM 分数中的代数和归一化运算。. ReLU units allow exact implementations of truncation and maximum-type operations, while ReQU units provide exact constructions of basic polynomial operations such as squares and products. This mixed architecture is therefore well suited to the algebraic and normalization operations in the GMM score.

备注5Remark 5.

In Theorem 1，ReLU–ReQU 网络用于构造方便。 ReQU单元以较小的深度精确地实现了乘法和其他多项式运算，从而简化了指数和归一化模块的构造并保持常数显式。选择并不重要：使用仅 ReLU 的前馈网络应该可以获得类似的近似率。然而，仅 ReLU 的构造将用更精细的分段线性近似代替精确的多项式模块，并且需要更复杂的组合。因此，我们使用混合 ReLU-ReQU 架构来将证明重点放在近似机制上，而不是算术的技术实现上。, ReLU–ReQU networks are used for constructive convenience. ReQU units realize multiplication and other polynomial operations exactly with small depth, which simplifies the construction of the exponential and normalization modules and keeps the constants explicit. The choice is not essential: similar approximation rates should be obtainable with ReLU-only feedforward networks. However, a ReLU-only construction would replace exact polynomial modules by finer piecewise-linear approximations and would require more elaborate compositions. We therefore use the mixed ReLU–ReQU architecture to keep the proof focused on the approximation mechanism rather than on technical implementations of arithmetic.

5 流量近似和稳定平衡蒸馏Flow Approximation and Stability-Balanced Distillation

In Section 4，我们在 GMM-OU 设置中建立了分数学习的近似结果。对于任何固定的, we established an approximation result for score learning in the GMM–OU setting. For any fixedtt，在合适的 ReLU-ReQU 假设类中，可以实现高精度近似, within a suitable ReLU–ReQU hypothesis class, one can achieve high-accuracy approximation inLp​(pt)L^{p}(p_{t})复杂度约为with complexity on the order ofpolylog​(ε−1)\mathrm{polylog}(\varepsilon^{-1})。因此，蒸馏的主要瓶颈往往不是能否适应. Consequently, the main bottleneck for distillation is often not whether one can fit𝒗​(⋅,t)\bm{v}(\cdot,t)每次都足够准确，而是如何通过长时间积分引起的流程图放大该误差。在本节中，我们通过概率流 ODE 的时间相关雅可比行列式的可计算界限来量化这种放大，使用所得的稳定性因子来证明深度残差组合对有限时间流图的有效近似结果，然后导出选择时间网格的实用原则。accurately enough at each time, but rather how this error is amplified by the flow map induced by long-time integration. In this section, we quantify such amplification through a computable bound on the time-dependent Jacobian of the probability-flow ODE, use the resulting stability factor to prove an efficient approximation result for finite-time flow maps by deep residual compositions, and then derive practical principles for choosing a time grid.

By contrast, the Lipschitz scale realizable by a student network is constrained by its architecture, including its depth, width, and weight scale. If the tail amplification factor exceeds this realizable Lipschitz scale, then a structural mismatch occurs. In this regime, even accurate fixed-time score approximation does not imply that a one-step student can reduce the accumulated trajectory error to the score approximation scale.

7 结论Conclusion

这项工作为蒸馏扩散模型提供了一个原则性的近似框架，并提供了理论保证和实用算法。我们证明，在各向同性 GMM-OU 设置中，目标分布的分数可以通过神经网络来近似，该神经网络的大小仅以多对数方式增长，并具有所需的精度。我们引入了稳定性曲线来量化误差如何随着时间的推移而放大，并表明，在低噪声多模态下，指数稳定性因子可以超过标准网络类别的 Lipschitz 预算。为了减轻这种不匹配，我们提出了一种残差架构，该架构由许多短间隔流近似组成，并证明了与稳定性指数和块数量成比例的误差界限。我们进一步设计了一种稳定性平衡的离散化，它在刚性状态下分配较小的步长，并通过经验验证，与均匀网格相比，它大大减少了端到端误差。总之，这些结果阐明了轨迹蒸馏的基本限制，并提出了设计学生和时间网格的实用策略。未来的工作可能会将分析扩展到更一般的数据分布，研究可学习性和优化动态，并探索其他架构，例如用于稳定性感知蒸馏的变压器。This work offers a principled approximation framework for distilling diffusion models and provides both theoretical guarantees and practical algorithms. We proved that, in the isotropic GMM–OU setting, the score of the target distribution can be approximated by neural networks whose size grows only polylogarithmically with the desired accuracy. We introduced a stability profile to quantify how errors amplify over time and showed that, in low‑noise multimodal regimes, the exponential stability factor can exceed the Lipschitz budget of standard network classes. To mitigate this mismatch, we proposed a residual architecture that composes many short‑interval flow approximations and proved an error bound that scales with the stability exponent and the number of blocks. We further devised a stability‑balanced discretization that allocates smaller step sizes in stiff regimes and empirically validated that it substantially reduces end‑to‑end error compared with uniform grids. Together, these results clarify the fundamental limits of trajectory distillation and suggest practical strategies for designing students and time grids. Future work may extend the analysis to more general data distributions, investigate learnability and optimization dynamics, and explore other architectures such as transformers for stability‑aware distillation.

At each layer, pair adjacent inputs and compute their maxima in parallel; if one input is left unpaired, it is passed to the next layer by the ReLU identity representation above. 证明将流图逼近误差分解为两个可控项。第一个是每个残差块的一阶增量形式引起的局部时间离散截断误差。第二个是由神经网络近似速度场（相当于分数）引起的矢量场误差。两种误差类型都会被流量稳定系数放大，其规模由下式决定：The proof decomposes the flow map approximation error into two controllable terms. The first is the local time-discretization truncation error caused by the first-order increment form of each residual block. The second is the vector-field error induced by approximating the velocity field, equivalently the score, by neural networks. Both error types are amplified by the flow stability factor, whose scale is governed byΛT=∫0TL​(t)​dt\Lambda_{T}=\int_{0}^{T}L(t)\mathrm{d}t.
